import Mathlib

theorem ae_zero_of_nonneg_measurable_lintegral_zero
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
    {f : Ω → ℝ} {E : Set Ω}
    (hf_meas : Measurable f)
    (hf_nonneg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)
    (hE_meas : MeasurableSet E)
    (hE_pos : 0 < μ E)
    (h_int_zero : ∫⁻ x in E, ENNReal.ofReal (f x) ∂μ = 0) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict E, f x = 0 := by
  have hg_meas : Measurable (λ x : Ω ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (f x)) :=
    ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp hf_meas
  have h_linteg_restrict_zero : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (f x) ∂(μ.restrict E)) = 0 := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.lintegral_restrict]
    exact h_int_zero
  rcases MeasureTheory.lintegral_eq_zero_iff hg_meas |>.mp h_linteg_restrict_zero with h
  filter_upwards [h] with x hx
  have hx' : f x ≤ 0 := (ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.mp hx)
  have hx0 : f x = 0 := le_antisymm hx' (hf_nonneg x)
  exact hx0

theorem ae_zero_of_nonneg_measurable_lintegral_zero
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
    {f : Ω → ℝ} {E : Set Ω}
    (hf_meas : Measurable f)
    (hf_nonneg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)
    (hE_meas : MeasurableSet E)
    (hE_pos : 0 < μ E)
    (h_int_zero : ∫⁻ x in E, ENNReal.ofReal (f x) ∂μ = 0) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict E, f x = 0 := by
  have hg_meas : Measurable (λ x : Ω ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (f x)) :=
    ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp hf_meas
  have h_linteg_restrict_zero : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (f x) ∂(μ.restrict E)) = 0 := by
    calc
      (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (f x) ∂(μ.restrict E)) = (∫⁻ x in E, ENNReal.ofReal (f x) ∂μ) := by
        rw [MeasureTheory.lintegral_restrict]
      _ = 0 := h_int_zero
  rcases MeasureTheory.lintegral_eq_zero_iff hg_meas |>.mp h_linteg_restrict_zero with h
  have h_ae : ∀ᵐ x ∂(μ.restrict E), ENNReal.ofReal (f x) = 0 := h
  apply h_ae.mono
  intro x hx
  have hx' : f x ≤ 0 := (ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.mp hx)
  have hx0 : f x = 0 := le_antisymm hx' (hf_nonneg x)
  exact hx0
